text: GO: JavaFX-first JVM backend is feasible using only public JavaFX 21 APIs. POINT_NORMAL_TEXCOORD + per-face 4x4 direct IntBuffer PixelBuffer atlas passes 7 structural tests; style/data update receipt proves geometryRebuilt=false, camera receipt proves zero atlas/mesh work, 300-face forced chunking is exact, lit/unlit PhongMaterial paths work. Atlas memory 3.875 MiB at 63,240 faces and 19.938 MiB at 326,382 faces. Full atlas replacement 6.8-11.6 ms at 32k and 28.2-35.8 ms at 164k.
